en.headline: Customs seize 5kg cannabis and 10 endangered turtles at airport
en.dek: Officers arrested a 37-year-old mainland man over cannabis buds worth about HK$1.1 million found in his suitcase after a Bangkok flight, and intercepted turtles in parcels from the United States.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected a drug trafficking case involving an incoming passenger at Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday and seized about 5 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about HK$1.1 million.
A 37-year-old mainland man arrived from Bangkok. During clearance, officers found the suspected cannabis buds inside his carry-on suitcase and arrested him. An investigation was continuing.

In a separate operation, Customs intercepted two parcels declared as plastic home products from the United States and found 10 live turtles of suspected scheduled endangered species, with a total estimated market value of about HK$100,000. The cases were handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

Customs reminded the public that trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment. Importing or possessing endangered species without proper authority is also an offence under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲5公斤大麻花及10隻受管制活龜
zh.dek: 37歲內地男旅客從曼谷抵港，手提行李藏約5公斤大麻花市值約110萬元被捕；另在美國包裹檢獲10隻懷疑瀕危活龜。
body: 香港海關表示，周六在香港國際機場偵破一宗涉及入境旅客的販毒案件，檢獲約5公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約110萬元。
37歲內地男子從曼谷抵港，海關人員在其手提行李發現該批大麻花後將他拘捕。調查仍在進行。
另一行動中，海關截獲兩個申報為塑膠家居用品、由美國寄來的包裹，發現10隻懷疑受管制瀕危物種活龜，估計市值約10萬元。案件已交漁農自然護理署跟進。
海關提醒，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可處罰款500萬元及終身監禁。非法進口或管有瀕危物種亦屬違法。
